input.quote: 14. INSURANCE. Throughout the term of this Agreement, Contractor shall maintain workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) and professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
input.rationale: An insurance clause exists (Section 14), so the rule is not missing, but it falls short of the preferred position in three respects: no CGL aggregate limit, E&O at USD 1M rather than USD 2M, and no cyber/privacy liability cover at all. Cyber cover is squarely relevant here because Contractor obtains Company Confidential Information including data and records (p0038), may access Company computer systems and works at Company facilities (p0007). Workers' compensation as required by statute and certificates on request are already satisfied. The redline raises E&O to USD 2M, adds the USD 2M CGL aggregate and USD 5M cyber/privacy cover, and extends the coverage period one year beyond the term consistent with our model language; fallback (E&O USD 1M plus cyber USD 2M) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Raise E&O to USD 2M, add CGL aggregate limit, add cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M, and extend coverage one year past term
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 14 already covers workers' compensation, CGL and E&O, but it omits cyber/privacy cover even though Contractor accesses our systems, facilities and Confidential Information, and the E&O limit sits below our standard. We have raised E&O to USD 2M, added the USD 2M CGL aggregate and USD 5M cyber/privacy cover, and extended the coverage period one year past termination to match claims-made policies; if USD 5M cyber is unavailable, we can accept USD 2M cyber with E&O at USD 1M.

ops.oldText: Throughout the term of this Agreement, Contractor shall maintain workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) and professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
ops.newText: Throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter, Contractor shall maintain, at its own expense, workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) per occurrence and two million dollars ($2,000,000) in the aggregate, professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least two million dollars ($2,000,000), and, where Contractor processes, stores or has access to Company data or Confidential Information, cyber and privacy liability insurance with coverage of at least five million dollars ($5,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
